name: High School Scholars Program, Middlesex College
what_you_do: Take real college courses during the school day, on campus or online, and earn college credit while still in high school.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 10 to 12 who are at least 15 years old.
pay_detail: $150 per course plus textbooks for in-county residents; students from other counties, states or countries pay the out-of-county rate (not listed).
duration: Courses of 3 to 4 credits; up to 8 credits per semester
deadline_text: No deadline listed on the page.
how_to_apply: Download the application and email it to k12partnerships@middlesexcollege.edu, or call 732-906-2554 to schedule a virtual appointment.
notes: Separate Dual Enrollment: in participating districts, college courses are taught at the high school. Ask your counselor.
